title: XXVI-XXXVIII: arcane and revealed; precise, modified, ample, limited
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): promises plus threats under a tacit condition. promissory, or minatory — as Abraham's sacrifice in Genesis 22; — and it stands as exploratory. XXXV–XXXVIII. And it stands as ample or limited. XXXII–XXXIV. And it stands as precise or modified. XXIX–XXXI. Revealed stands as that same that which stands as made plain by means belonging toward God's sign or by means belonging toward ye event belonging toward ye thing — ye will belonging toward sign. XXVIII. it stands as not to be searched out, Deuteronomy 29:29. Arcane stands as that same that which stands as hidden out from ye intelligent creature as long as it seems good to God — ye good pleasure belonging toward Ephesians 1; XXVII. SIXTH, God's will stands as arcane or revealed. XXVI.
pass_b_english: XXVI. SIXTH, God's will is arcane or revealed. XXVII. Arcane is that which is hidden from the intelligent creature as long as it seems good to God — the good pleasure of Ephesians 1; it is not to be searched out, Deuteronomy 29:29. XXVIII. Revealed is that which is made plain by God's sign or by the event of the thing — the will of sign.

XXIX–XXXI. And it is precise or modified. XXXII–XXXIV. And it is ample or limited. XXXV–XXXVIII. And it is exploratory, promissory, or minatory — as Abraham's sacrifice in Genesis 22; promises and threats under a tacit condition.
source_text: XXVI. SEXTO, voluntas Dei est arcana aut revelata. XXVII. Arcana est quae creaturae intelligenti, quamdiu Deo visum, abscondita est — beneplacitum Ephes. I; non est perscrutanda, Deut. XXIX.29. XXVIII. Revelata est quae signo Dei aut eventu rei patefacta est — voluntas signi. XXIX-XXXI. Estque praecisa aut modificata. XXXII-XXXIV. Estque ampla aut limitata. XXXV-XXXVIII. Estque exploratoria, promissoria, aut comminatoria — ut Abrahami sacrificium Gen. XXII; promissiones et comminationes sub tacita conditione.
